expo.name: Gambot
expo.description: Gambot is a B2B enterprise companion app for the Gambot CRM platform. This app is designed exclusively for organizations, businesses, and their employees who have been provisioned an account by their organization administrator. It is NOT available for individual consumer purchase or self-service signup. All billing and subscription management is handled outside the app through enterprise sales contracts between Gambot Ltd. and organizations. There is no mechanism within the app to purchase, upgrade, or subscribe to any service. This app serves solely as a mobile interface for existing enterprise CRM accounts.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gambot needs access to your camera to take photos and videos to share in chats.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gambot needs access to your photo library to share images and media files in chats.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Gambot uses your location to verify that you are at your workplace when clocking in or out (location-based time reporting).

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Gambot to access your photos to share media in chats.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Gambot to access your camera to take photos and videos.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow Gambot to access your calendar to create events.
